profile.headline: Software Engineer Lead
profile.summary: Software Engineer Lead with over 10 years of experience, worked with several industries, I have experience in all kind of development like Backend, Frontend and Mobile. I can lead developing teams and being part of the development process. My goal is to use my knowledge to create solutions that will help clients and persons that uses them in their daily processes.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
As Software Engineering Lead I use my knowledge to help the company on the creation of solutions for several clients using the best practices and technologies.

Key Engagements:
• Ford Motor Company, Built and delivered a new global training site for multiple countries using Angular 6-13, Typescript, HTML, CSS and Java.
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Technical Project Leadership · Angular · TypeScript · HTML5 · CSS

positions.title: Software Engineering Lead
positions.description:
As Software Engineering Lead I use my knowledge to help the company on the creation of solutions for several clients using the best practices and technologies.

Key Engagements:
• Ford Motor Company, Built and delivered a new global training site for multiple countries using Angular 6-13, Typescript, HTML, CSS and Java.

• Wells Fargo, Collaborated on the creation of a web application used for display and generate banking partnerships with retailers using Angular12, Typescript, HTML, CSS and .NET

positions.title: Software Engineering Lead
positions.description:
As Technical Lead I have a team of 6 Engineers reporting directly to me, I also design, develop and deliver several projects and solutions for several clients based in the USA, specializing more into the frontend development

Key Engagements:
• Suddath (USA), Part of the Mexico’s team that helped to create a Front-End application using Angular 9+, NgRx, Typescript, HTML, CSS and C#. All this helped to improve Suddath moving process a 55%

• Lockton (USA), Led the Mexico's team that created a Front-End application from scratch, helping Lockton to improve the insurance sales potential with a more intuitive tool using Angular 8, NgRx and D3.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer I helped to build several solutions to clients based in Mexico and the United States to help them in their daily processes being part of the development team, and also led these teams in several projects to deliver stable and scalable products to clients covering frontend, backend and mobile development.

Key Engagements
• Coca-Cola (USA, Sep 2019, Nov 2019), Developed a Web application using Java, Javascript, MicroStrategy SDK, helping users to minimize times of searching important data since now they are able to create hourly/daily/monthly subscriptions.

• Pfizer (USA, Feb 2019, Sep 2019), Led Mexico's team that helped to create a Front-End application using NgRx, Angular 5, Electron, Spring Framework, helping Pfizer to have a more visual tool for all the process in the development and testing of a new drug.

• Merck (USA, Sep 2018, Sep 2018), Developed a MicroStrategy Web and Mobile plugin using Java, Objective-C, MicroStrategy Web and Mobile SDK, improving the dashboard visualization of the MicroStrategy App, for a custom made style and moving the classic login to an OAuth authentication.

• CVS (USA, Apr 2018, Sep 2018), Developed a MicroStrategy Web and Mobile plugin using Java, Objective-C, MicroStrategy Web and Mobile SDK, helping CVS to improve the taking of decisions since now they can consult more real time data.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer I provided solutions to clients based on Mexico and the United States and help them to implement this solutions in several environments, technologies and industries. Being part of al process from design to implementation and different ends like Frontend, Backend and Mobile development.

Key Engagements:

• GMD (Mexico, Jun 2017 – Mar 2018), Developed a Web and Hybrid Mobile Application using Ionic Framework for the mobile app, and Java Spring MVC for the restAPI, improving GMD's process for all constructions projects and
helping them to manage better the working objectives.

• Bonton (USA, Jan 2017 – Jun 2017), Developed a Web Application using Java Spring MVC Framework, JavaScript, JQuery, helping Bonton's sales managers to have a better communication with providers and showing them how a
product can be displayed to improve its sales.

• Lázaro Cárdenas TPC (Mexico, Nov 2016 – Dec 2016), Developed a Web Application using AngularJS and Java Spring MVC Framework, allowing LCTPC to have a system with dynamic forms that allowed them to improve their control of the containers in their terminal and the prices charged to the containers companies.

• Lincoln Financial Services (USA, Aug 2016 – Nov 2016), Developed a Mobile Application using Objective-C and MicroStrategy Mobile SDK, helping LFS to have a more intuitive tool where as they can execute reports with voice recognition and get significant data just by asking questions like "Who is my Top Salesman?".

positions.title: Ingeniero de software
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer, I helped to create significative tools for helping several clients based on Mexico and the United States in their daily processes, I was part in several projects and several technologies covering frontend, backend and mobile development

Key Engagements:

• Alsea (Mexico, Mar 2015 – Jan 2016), Developed a CRUD Web Application using Hibernate Java Framework, improving Alsea's working time since they don't have to load spreadsheets by hand anymore, instead they just charge them into the system and the system insert all the information in the DBs by parsing it from the spreadsheets.

• PIMCO (Mexico, Oct 2013 – Jan 2014), Developed a MicroStrategy Mobile plugin for the MicroStrategy App using Objective C and MicroStrategy Mobile SDK, allowing PIMCO to have a custom made Login and landscape customized inside MicroStrategy App.
